title: Pan-Seared Pork Canton with Citrusy Filipino Flare
description: A fusion twist on the classic French dish, featuring pan-seared pork and canton noodles, with a hint of citrusy Filipino flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, and citrusy Filipino seasoning blend.
2. Add the pork pieces to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Cook the canton noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
4. In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
5. Remove the pork from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
6. Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
7. Add the ginger and garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
8. Stir in the cooked noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
9. Squeeze the orange juice over the top and toss to coat.
10. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
